# Release Notes

## Features
- [#201] Live notification bell in the navigation header displays updates in real time.
- [#202] Invite multiple team members simultaneously by uploading a CSV roster.

## Fixes
- [#203] Resolved memory leak caused by uncleaned WebSocket heartbeat event listeners.
- [#204] Prevented duplicate form submissions during slow payment checkouts.

## Breaking Changes
- [#205] Administrative API tokens now strictly mandate multi-factor authentication (MFA).
